notes.title: New Map, New Note UI & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Added a new Carnival map with new areas.

- Reworked note system and UI to make it more user friendly.

- Balanced note amounts for less or more players.

- Fixed some players not being able to see notes.

- Fixed note counter not working correctly in some cases.

- Fixed notes spawning under the map sometimes.

- Fixed a large amount of other bugs.

We have been listening to feedback and are looking at adding some more content to the game loop, this will include random encounters and jump scares ingame on every map to make it more fun and engaging.

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Balancing & Achievements
notes.content:
- Fixed note spawning in grass nearly being impossible to find.

- Added how to play menu to help newer players understand mechanics in lobby.

- Delayed the initial spawn of Frostgrim so players don't get hunted right away.

- Fixed player revives bugging out and not being able to be revived.

- Fixed note collection so it doesn't kick players when being knocked out.

- Added only 4 notes needed for 2 players, more players will be the standard 8.

- Added a warning message on the menu regarding some players lagging when players connect to lobby.

- Added some basic achievements. 

- Fixed a bunch of other minor bugs.


We appreciate all the feedback so far and are looking at adding further maps/content shortly.
